verified.story_title: FERC issues show-cause orders to six RTOs/ISOs on AI data-center interconnection; Alaska's Railbelt sits outside the framework
verified.summary: On June 18, 2026 FERC issued show-cause orders to PJM, MISO, SPP, CAISO, ISO-NE, and NYISO directing them to fix large-load (AI data-center) interconnection rules found inadequate for surging demand. Alaska's Railbelt grid operates outside every RTO/ISO, so no federal interconnection floor applies; the Regulatory Commission of Alaska would be the only body positioned to set equivalent large-load rules.
verified.industry_consequence: Sets a federal benchmark for large-load interconnection that Alaska's Railbelt will not be subject to; the RCA has a near-term window to write its own large-load rules before the next AI data-center project forces project-by-project negotiation.

verified.story_title: DNR reviews STAK Energy North Slope AI data-center lease after comment window closed
verified.summary: Alaska DNR's public comment window on the preliminary best-interest finding for STAK Energy's 715.4-acre, 50-year Dalton Highway lease (near MP 390) closed June 15, 2026; DNR is now in review before a final finding that would authorize a natural-gas-powered HPC/AI data-center campus. Reported project cost is about $500 million.
verified.industry_consequence: A final best-interest finding (expected in coming weeks) would clear the state-land gate for what could be Alaska's first utility-scale AI compute campus and the first large load to test the Railbelt/North Slope grid's missing interconnection rules.

verified.story_title: Air Force seeks commercial AI data-center tenants at JBER, Eielson, and Clear SFS; proposals due June 29
verified.summary: The Department of the Air Force is offering parcels at Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson, Eielson AFB, and Clear Space Force Station to commercial AI data-center developers who would finance, build, and operate the facilities; initial proposals are due June 29, 2026.
verified.industry_consequence: June 29 is the first filter on whether serious operators will bid on Alaska military land for AI compute; a thin field would signal that power and connectivity constraints still block commercial decisions.

verified.story_title: Senate Armed Services Committee advances FY2027 NDAA 18-9 with about $2.6B in Alaska military projects
verified.summary: On June 23, 2026 the Senate Armed Services Committee advanced the FY2027 NDAA by an 18-9 vote. Per Sen. Dan Sullivan's office, 56 provisions carry a projected $2.6 billion in Alaska military construction, including a JBER Fighter Town recapitalization, $50 million for expanded launch capacity at the Pacific Spaceport Complex on Kodiak, and $41 million for an Eielson Range Operations Center. This is a committee-advanced authorization, not an appropriation.
verified.industry_consequence: Largest single-cycle Alaska defense-construction authorization sought in recent memory; Alaska and ANC contractors face a 6-12 month window to position teaming and bonding if the bill clears Congress by fall 2026.

verified.story_title: Alaska RHTP application portal closed June 22 with 400+ tech projects
verified.summary: Alaska's Rural Health Transformation Program full-application portal closed June 22, 2026 with more than 400 projects advancing; the program drew federal funding of about $272 million (total program, not a Year-1 figure), with project awards expected around August 1. Tanana Chiefs Conference drone delivery and AI wearable proposals were reported earlier (June 9).
verified.industry_consequence: Tribal health orgs and vendors face a mid-July evaluation and August 1 award that compress drone and remote-monitoring pilots into a sub-12-month deployment window.
